policy.research: Identical visible/affordable portfolio, repeatables up to level 3, common node order. Paid craft priority differs only by target loadout. No item grants or acquired third-slot claim.
policy.limits: Early feasibility check, not mature three-slot comparison or long-term dominant-build proof. Equal research freedom, not identical realized research history; finite resources and job timing differ.
